learned.title: Lantern Decimal JSON serialisation: use serde::str, never arbitrary_precision
learned.knowledge: For JSON (de)serialisation of rust_decimal::Decimal in Lantern, use #[serde(with = "rust_decimal::serde::str")] so amounts are always JSON strings, preserving precision for JS clients.
